mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 53 degrees and clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is currently in a Waxing Gibbous phase. If you have clear skies tonight, keep an eye out for the International Space Station starting at 5:49 PM; it will rise in the Northwest near Verona High School and head toward the Northeast near Home Depot.

The City of Verona has announced that city buildings will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27, which will also delay refuse and recycling pickup to Friday. Additionally, the city is moving forward with a space needs evaluation for a new public works and utilities facility to better serve our growing population.
There is plenty to do with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company happening tomorrow.
On November 4, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in a parking lot on East Verona Avenue where a 34-year-old woman was arrested for O W I with a child in the vehicle.
Satisfy your cravings with today's flavor, Crazy for Cookie Dough, and remember that the shop opens today at 10:00 AM.
